about: Desktop band, 1280x800, mouse, no touch, dpr 1. The page runs as served: text-wrap: balance on the people card title (applied only above 860 px) is in force. The container has a system font (task counts-lane-fonts), so the layout never runs with no font at all, which is what crashed Chrome 156 on that title. The user agent is the Linux desktop one (viewport.mobile false, Fw.Measure.Profile userAgent); the site does not branch on the user agent. Counts taken before task counts-lane-fonts (runs 39868985767, 39869000429) had text-wrap: wrap on every element and an image with no system font; research/notes/2026/10-2x-counts-lane-fonts.md compares them.
